Hyundai Motor Group to Invest $15.5 Billion in India by 2032

Hyundai Motor Group announced an investment of $15.5 billion (approximately ₹1.47 lakh crore) in India through 2032. This seven-year plan, covering both Hyundai Motor India and Kia, aims to expand manufacturing capacity, strengthen local supplier networks, and boost research and development by $700 million. The investment is intended to position India as a global export hub and a key driver of future growth for the company, with the goal of reclaiming market share from domestic rivals.
